name: 85611 · Elgin, AZ
findings: ZIP 85611 (Elgin) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (70%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85611 (Elgin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85611 (Elgin) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 8.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
